title: Claude Code 2.1.143 - Plugin Dependency Enforcement and Projected Context Costs
description: Release 2.1.143 on May 15, 2026, added plugin dependency enforcement to prevent breaking changes, projected context cost displays in the plugin marketplace, and numerous fixes including background session preservation, PowerShell tool improvements, and worktree cleanup safety enhancements.

title: Claude Code 2.1.142 - New Agent Flags and Fast Mode Opus 4.7
description: Release 2.1.142 on May 14, 2026, introduced new claude agents flags for configuring dispatched background sessions, Fast mode now uses Opus 4.7 by default, and included critical fixes for macOS sleep/wake daemon reconnection and background session recognition of git worktrees.

title: Claude Code 2.1.141 - Terminal Sequence Hooks and Agent View Navigation
description: Release 2.1.141 on May 13, 2026, added terminalSequence field to hook JSON output for desktop notifications without terminal, improved agent view navigation shortcuts, enhanced auto mode permission dialog explanations, and fixed numerous issues including focus mode behavior and MCP OAuth refresh token race conditions.

title: Claude Code 2.1.140 - Agent Tool Matching and Theme Picker
description: Release 2.1.140 on May 12, 2026, improved Agent tool subagent_type matching to accept case- and separator-insensitive values, updated agent color palette, and fixed /goal silent hangs, settings hot-reload symlink issues, and background service startup failures on enterprise endpoint security.

title: Claude Code 2.1.139 - Agent View Research Preview and /goal Command
description: Release 2.1.139 on May 11, 2026, introduced agent view (Research Preview) as a single list of every Claude Code session, added /goal command to set completion conditions for continuous work, added /scroll-speed command, claude plugin details, and transcript view navigation improvements.

title: Copilot Memory User-Level Preferences
description: Copilot Memory now supports user-level preferences in early access for Copilot Pro and Pro+ users. The feature allows Copilot to store stated or implicit preferences and use that knowledge in future work for more personalized assistance.

title: GitHub Copilot App Technical Preview
description: GitHub announced the Copilot app is now available in technical preview, featuring a GitHub-native desktop experience to steer, validate, and ship in one place. Users can review plans and diffs, see what changed, leave feedback, and guide iterations with agentic workflows.

title: Team-Level Copilot Usage Metrics via API
description: Team-level Copilot usage metrics are now available via API, providing organizations with better visibility into how their teams are using Copilot features and seats.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent Auto Model Selection
description: Copilot cloud agent now supports auto model selection, automatically choosing the appropriate model for tasks based on context and requirements.

title: Copilot CLI Agent and Unified Sessions in JetBrains
description: Introduced Copilot CLI agent and unified sessions view in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs, improving the developer experience for CLI interactions within the IDE.

title: Start Copilot Cloud Agent Tasks via REST API
description: Developers can now start Copilot cloud agent tasks via the REST API, enabling programmatic control and integration into automated workflows.

title: Cursor 3.3 - Cloud Agent Reliability Fixes
description: Cursor released version 3.3 with critical fixes for cloud agent timing and hydration edge cases that could degrade reliability. The update also includes new development environment tools for teams, multi-repo environment support, improved Dockerfile-based configuration with build secrets, and a new PR review experience in Cursor 3.

community_feedback.quote: Fixed various cloud agent timing and hydration edge cases that could degrade reliability

title: Development Environments for Cloud Agents
description: Cursor introduced new tools for teams to configure development environments for their agents, including multi-repo environments, environment configuration as code with Dockerfile-based support, improved agent-led environment setup, and governance/security controls with version history and audit logs.

title: Cursor in Microsoft Teams Integration
description: Cursor is now available in Microsoft Teams. Users can mention @Cursor in any Teams channel to delegate tasks to cloud agents or pull information from Cursor. The integration automatically selects the right repository and model based on prompt and recent activity.

title: PR Review, Build Plan in Parallel, and Split PRs
description: New PR review experience in Cursor 3 with inline review threads, commits tab, and changes tab. Cursor can now execute plans faster by multitasking across parallel agents, and users can split changes into PRs with built-in quick actions.
